items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: Willie Foster? ... Willie Foster. Willie Foster. His first instrument that I could recall, or I would, was a violin.

ctx.x: And then I was up in Baton Rouge about two years ago. And we interviewed Willie Foster, one of the old-time guitar players. He played guitar, I think, more than he did banjo.
Yes. The brother of Pops Foster, George Foster, the bass player.
